title: LeBron James and a lifetime of basketball
text:
Wow!  grew up with LeBron, followed his career for 20+ years, finally will be finishing his career (with me) in Philly!  What a man!  

Recall the Freakonomics podcast recently with Steve Kerr, who played with LeBron, Michael Jordon, and coached Steph Curry at Golden State, and his effusive comments on who the GOAT really is!

With Maxey, Jaylen Brown (small forward from the Celtics recently), VJ, and Wade (power forward from the Cavs), LeBron will be a great addition!  The major concern is of course, Joel and his staying power!  Instantly, Sixers have transformed themselves!  Kalshi betting odds has the Sixers in 3rd place for winning it all (behind OKC, NY-K)!  

What does it say about LeBron that he signed for a pittance ($4M/yr for 2 years)? A billionaire still hungry for another ring, to stay relevant?

How fun!
